comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus insert two cable connectors and route their shared slack into a guide.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses rigid two-tool rotational coordination; the cable task uses precision connector insertion and flexible-chain routing without pulling seated plugs loose.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires angle retention across motion cycles; the cable task requires both plugs released and seated for 20 controls plus the collar released in the guide.
comparison.reason: Retention after cable routing concerns insertion and tension management, not locknut countertorque or calibrated stop adjustment.
